summary: #346: DuckDB's DECIMAL(p, p) text needs no core option: `dtextFull` is proved equal to `dtext`, DuckDB lowers it only through widening, and the SQL lift refuses `CAST(DECIMAL(p,p) AS VARCHAR)` as a listed D54 dialect difference whose message names the cast to DECIMAL(p+1, p).
note: Amends ruling 244 (b) (E1-E6). DuckDB at DECIMAL(38,38) is refused in verify's report, never at run time. A decimal_text option is After 1.0, on request.
